name: police-and-control-audit-specs
description: Turns a Police & Control business request into a finalised, DNA-ready auditing dashboard spec, a UI mockup artifact, and the Jira tickets that hand it over. Runs the full pipeline: intake, Snowflake data-existence check (metadata-only when no warehouse grant exists), ERP table discovery via Ask the Code, feedback questioning loop, UI example, final spec, DNA handoff. Carries a catalogue of the spec defects that have actually cost rework.
